items.notes: Added explicit 'Ensure Redis data directory exists' task for /var/lib/redis (owner: redis, group: redis, mode: 0750) immediately after package install. The role must not rely on the redis package side-effect to create this directory.

items.description: Molecule verify playbook — checks /var/lib/redis/health_check.json (exists, owner redis:redis, mode 0644, valid JSON), /var/log/redis (directory, owner redis:redis, mode 0755), /opt/myapp/version.txt (contains 2.1.0), /opt/myapp (directory), /etc/redis/redis.conf (bind, port, requirepass, maxmemory, appendonly, appendfsync), Redis port 6379 responding, health check endpoint reachable
items.notes: Generated verify.yml split into 4 plays: (1) service facts for redis/chronyd/rsyslog + port 6379 wait_for, (2) stat checks for key paths with ownership/mode assertions, (3) slurp-based content checks for version.txt/health_check.json/redis.conf directives, (4) health endpoint URI check and schedulerctl query assertion.
